prose: The brilliant Dr. Christopher McIntosh returns to InnerVerse. In this free extended episode, we discuss his new book The Call of the Old Gods. Enjoy this deep journey into mythic consciousness and timeless wisdom!
topics: His "hermetic baptism" and early mystical initiation
The return of Paganism as a living, local tradition
The meaning and power of runes as oracles and embodied practices
Cyclical time vs linear time, and how monotheism broke the circle
Ritual practice, initiatory experiences, and the mystery schools
Scholarship as a form of personal initiation
How modernity erodes cultural memory, and how the old gods still call
